format: NetCDF4 (one whole 380 MB file per scenario, 1460 six-hourly no-leap steps)
unverified: The forcing variables SamudrACE requests are defined by the checkpoint (get_forcing_window_data_requirements, models/px/samudrace.py:205-221), not in code; checkpoint not loaded, fme not installed. The list is the four SamudrACELexicon variables actually present in forcing_0311.nc (HGTsfc, DSWRFtoa, land_fraction, lake_fraction); the model may request a subset.
notes: Default forcing source of SamudrACE.load_model (scenario 0311). Times are matched by month/day/hour ignoring year; Feb 29 and off-6-hour times raise.

cache=True (default) stores downloads in the shared HuggingFace hub cache (HF_HOME, samudrace.py:171-172), NOT under EARTH2STUDIO_CACHE: the harness cache wipe does not make trials cold (cache_bytes reports 0). Point HF_HOME at a wiped directory per trial for a true cold run.
Download size is fixed (380 MB) regardless of variable count. Small real fetch (mtdwswrf, land_abs) passed in 18 s.
ocean_abs and sic_abs are in the lexicon as forcing names but are not in the forcing file (KeyError).
